title: auto's own parent-selection strategy
domain: combinatorial search / the loop's own internals

metric.name: mean_best
metric.description: Mean best NK fitness found within a fixed 80-evaluation budget, averaged over 40 held-out landscapes. Range 0-1. Random selection scores ~0.630; auto's current strategy ~0.690.

gates.reason: The strategy must always return a valid archive index. A strategy that sometimes returns garbage is not a strategy.
A strategy that raises on any landscape is not usable in the real loop.
Train minus holdout. A strategy that beats train by more than 5 points has been fitted to the training landscapes rather than to the problem (SpecBench's delta). Pre-registered before the run.

holdout.description: 40 NK landscapes generated from seeds 5000-5039, held in harness/holdout_seeds.json. The solution develops against seeds 1000-1039 in harness/train_seeds.json and is scored only on the holdout draw.
